---
title: 'Epigenetics'
title-block-banner: false
---

A second-cycle course at Umeå University on the biology of chromatin and DNA
methylation, the sequencing assays that measure them, and how to analyse the
data: from raw reads on the command line to interpretation in R.

## Where to start

- [**Course plan**](courseplan.md): the official syllabus.
- [**Learning outcomes**](elo.md): what we are trying to teach.

## Before you start

- [**Install the software you need**](intro/install.qmd): do this before you start the first unit.

## Topics

Work through the sidebar from top to bottom. Each unit lists its lecture, quiz
and exercises in teaching order.

- **Foundations:** what epigenetics is (chromatin, histone marks, DNA methylation), and genomic intervals on the command line and in R.

*The material is under construction: more blocks are added as they are written.*

**See Canvas for the most up to date study instructions.**
